title: Disputing something that can't be disputed
story: The wallet app tries to dispute a payment that hasn't been taken yet, and is refused. Once the money is taken, the Dispute opens. Trying to dispute the same payment a second time is refused too.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: That FreshMart payment: I never authorised it.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: I don't remember agreeing to this FreshMart charge. I've told my bank I never authorised it.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Did my complaint go through? Disputing it again to be sure.

what_to_notice: Only a captured Payment can be disputed (PAYMENT_NOT_DISPUTABLE), and only once (PAYMENT_ALREADY_DISPUTED). Each refusal says why, and neither writes anything, so the records stay clean.
